name: Extract summary measures within tissue types
summary: Computes the mean and standard deviation of diffusion (DTI, DKI, NODDI), quantitative MRI and myelin maps within gray matter, white matter, CSF and the whole brain defined by a 5-tissue-type mask, and outputs a CSV.
description: Splits the 5-tissue-type image with MRtrix3 into gray matter, white matter and CSF maps binarised at 0.5, reslices each provided measure map to that grid with FreeSurfer mri_vol2vol (header-based, nearest neighbour), and writes per-tissue mean and SD of every measure to tissues.csv. Use it for a quick tissue-level summary of microstructure measures. Needs a 5-tissue-type mask and at least one of the tensor, NODDI, qMRI or myelin inputs, aligned to it. Note: in this branch the CSF mask is binarised from the gray matter map (convert.sh), so CSF values are not reliable.

inputs.description: 5-tissue-type segmentation (MRtrix3 5tt format) defining gray matter, white matter and CSF.
Optional tensor/kurtosis maps (fa, md, rd, ad, ga, ak, mk, rk).
Optional quantitative MRI maps (t1, r1, m0, pd, mtv, vip, sir, wf).

outputs.description: tissues.csv with mean and SD of each measure in gray_matter, white_matter, csf and wholebrain.
Intermediate tissue masks and resliced measure maps.

citations.text: Avesani P. et al. The open diffusion data derivatives. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).
Woolrich M.W. et al. Bayesian analysis of neuroimaging data in FSL. NeuroImage 45:S173-86 (2009).
Smith S.M. et al. Advances in functional and structural MR image analysis and implementation as FSL. NeuroImage 23(S1):208-19 (2004).

failure_modes.cause: No FreeSurfer license in the environment.
failure_modes.fix: Set the FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable on the compute resource.

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check logs and derivatives
failure_modes.fix: Check the log; make sure the measure maps and the 5tt mask are aligned.
